scope: 26 q-invalid responses among previous dense55 only; not all historical low-count images

methods.candidate_deletion: Try deleting each zero-based index from a temporary copy and call existing normalize_geometry; store every valid candidate; uniqueness only conditional on this parser, never confirms accidental point.
methods.candidate_graph: Each pair requires circular horizontal difference <51.2 pixels and vertical difference >=1 pixel, separately from q threshold.
methods.exact_matching: For each connected component, memoize remaining-vertex tuples; enumerate each allowed partner of smallest remaining vertex, combine recursive results and retain two lowest distinct pairings. Combine component optima; the global second-best increment is minimum component second-best gap. No coordinate or q modification.
methods.independent_check: Existing analyze_layout_pairing exhaustively completed each 28-point component separately: nodes 2/2/7/36/2255; total best and second gap match. Six-point enumeration cross-check and no-matching case also pass.
methods.wall_order: Reordered diagnostic copy only demonstrates existing parser can evaluate the computed pairs. Does not confirm intended final wall adjacency.

fields.records.json: one response per entry; exact IDs, original count, effective points, complete candidate indices, pairing graph/components, optimal pairings, unchanged flags, actual visual notes
fields.records.csv: same26 rows; nested values encoded as JSON, point indices zero based
fields.independent_matching_checks.json: two28-point responses, existing solver independent component results
